command:
cat > /root/vrrp_gateway.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure VyOS routers with VRRP shared gateway on lan-a and lan-b
  hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Render VRRP configuration script
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/vyos_vrrp.sh.j2
        dest: /tmp/vyos_vrrp.sh
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Apply VRRP configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: bash /tmp/vyos_vrrp.sh
      register: vyos_result
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_result.stdout"

    - name: Show resulting VRRP state
      ansible.builtin.command: >-
        bash -c "source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template; configure; run show vrrp"
      register: vrrp_state
      changed_when: false

    - name: Print VRRP state
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: vrrp_state.stdout_lines

- name: Configure node3/node4 static addressing and failover route via VRRP gateway
  hosts: hosts
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Set static IP on the LAN interface
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "Wired connection 2"
        ifname: "{{ iface }}"
        type: ethernet
        method4: manual
        ip4: "{{ local_ip }}"
        state: present

    - name: Add static route to the remote LAN via the shared VRRP gateway
      community.general.nmcli:
        conn_name: "Wired connection 2"
        ifname: "{{ iface }}"
        type: ethernet
        method4: manual
        ip4: "{{ local_ip }}"
        routes4: "{{ remote_net }} {{ gateway }}"
        state: present
      register: nm_result

    - name: Bring the connection up
      ansible.builtin.command: nmcli con up "Wired connection 2"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Verify route to remote LAN
      ansible.builtin.command: ip route show "{{ remote_net }}"
      register: route_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Print route
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: route_check.stdout_lines
EOF
echo OK
